newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenbao posts 11-fold rise in 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: Shenbao posts 11-fold rise in 1996 net.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.31 yuan vs 0.03 yuan
Net assets per share 1.93 yuan vs 1.62 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Shenbao Industrial Co Ltd .
Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international standards, the company posted net profits of 48.37 million yuan for 1996. It did not give a comparative figure.

The firm has proposed a one-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits and another one-for-10 bonus issue based on capital surplus, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 23, Shenbao said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, according to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
